_comment: Coolify 'Railpack' build pack (the default): same pipeline as deploy/Dockerfile — build the frontend, then the Go binary with the UI embedded — driven by Railpack's Go provider. Node 22 is added for Vite; pnpm is fetched at the version pinned in web/package.json (packageManager). Secrets (SECUREVAULT_MASTER_KEY, DATABASE_URL) are set in Coolify, never here.

commands: cd web && npx --yes pnpm@11 install --frozen-lockfile && npx --yes pnpm@11 build
